Specification: This module is a small test specification that exercises basic TLA+ set, sequence, range, quantifier, conditional, and TLC printing constructs. It models a single-variable system with variable x initialized to 2, checks a collection of simple mathematical identities and existential properties in Init, and then allows only stuttering steps via Next. The design is intentionally lightweight and uses TLC's Print operator to report progress of the tests; it defines an invariant Inv == TRUE and does not include any nontrivial temporal liveness or fairness properties.
IfThenElse: IF BdedSeq({x}, 2) # {<<>>, <<2>>, <<2,2>>} THEN Print("Failed Test 7", TRUE) ELSE Print("Test 7 OK", TRUE)
